meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大目标拆成一步步可核对的执行,跑到一半也能存档接着跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常跑多步骤长任务,又希望中途能停、断了能接着跑
copy.tagline_en: Break a big goal into verifiable steps and run it through, resuming anytime
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run long multi-step tasks and want to pause and resume safely

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把工作拆成逐条极细的步骤：先登记目标，把每个原子动作镜像进实时清单，并为每条成功标准收集可观察证据，长任务按检查点可恢复。
howto.when: 当你要求 ulw-loop / ulw、持久化的目标执行、或带检查点的长任务交付时接管。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 登记这个目标并开始执行
say.note: 会先按文档定义目标和成功标准

say.text: 看一下 ulw-loop 当前状态和待办清单
say.note: 读取 .omo/ulw-loop 下的会话状态

say.text: 为这条成功标准收集可验证的证据
say.note: 从终端、HTTP 或浏览器等渠道取证

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude breaks work into ultra-granular steps: it registers goals, mirrors each atomic action into a live checklist, gathers observable evidence for each success criterion, and checkpoints long runs for resume.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for ulw-loop or ulw, durable goal execution, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Run ulw-loop, register this goal, then start executing
say_en.note: Registers goal and success criteria first

say_en.text: Show the current ulw-loop status and checklist
Collect verifiable evidence for this success criterion
say_en.note: Captures proof from a real channel
